title: Past Simple
explanation: Use the past simple for finished actions at a specific time in the past. Regular verbs add -ed (work → worked). Many common verbs are irregular (go → went, have → had, buy → bought). Negatives and questions use did + base verb: I didn't go. Did you see it?
explanationPersian: از گذشته ساده برای کارهای تمام‌شده در زمان مشخصی در گذشته استفاده می‌شود. فعل‌های باقاعده ed- می‌گیرند و بسیاری از فعل‌های پرکاربرد بی‌قاعده‌اند. در منفی و سوالی از did با شکل ساده فعل استفاده کنید.

examples.english: We watched a film last night.

examples.persian: او در سال ۲۰۲۲ به شیراز رفت.

exercises.incorrectSentence: I didn't went to the party.
acceptedAnswers: I didn't go to the party.
exercises.explanation: After didn't, use the base verb: didn't go, not didn't went.
exercises.explanationPersian: بعد از didn't شکل ساده فعل می‌آید: didn't go.

exercises.explanation: Past questions: Did + subject + base verb.
exercises.explanationPersian: سؤال گذشته: Did + فاعل + فعل ساده.

exercises.explanation: Study → studied (y changes to i before -ed).
exercises.explanationPersian: study → studied (قبل از -ed حرف y به i تبدیل می‌شود).

exercises.source: دیروز به سینما رفتیم و یک فیلم خوب دیدیم.
acceptedAnswers: We went to the cinema yesterday and saw a good film.
Yesterday we went to the cinema and saw a good film.
We went to the cinema yesterday and watched a good film.
We went to the cinema yesterday and saw a good movie.
Yesterday we went to the cinema and saw a good movie.
exercises.explanationPersian: went (از go) و saw (از see): گذشتهٔ بی‌قاعده

commonErrors.feedback: After 'Did' use the base verb: see.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از Did فعل ساده می‌آید: see.

exercises.prompt: Make it negative: "I watched TV last night."
acceptedAnswers: I didn't watch TV last night.
I did not watch TV last night.

commonErrors.feedback: After didn't use the base verb: watch.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از didn't فعل ساده می‌آید: watch.
